description: Fetch one archived snapshot by its id (the 40-hex id that origin_status returns): the list of branches and tags the repository had at that capture, each with the id and type of what it points at (revision, release, directory, or an alias such as HEAD -> refs/heads/main). Follow a revision target into the revision tool. Accepts a bare hex id or a SWHID ("swh:1:snp:<hex>"). Branch lists can be long: use limit and the returned next_branch as branch_from to page. Sourced from the Software Heritage archive.

branch_from.description: Start the branch list at this branch name (use next_branch from a previous response).

id.description: Snapshot id, 40 hex characters ("46f80e4e5d2d65c79f728d7dda059ec3c1d8bae8") or a SWHID ("swh:1:snp:46f80e4e...").

name_include.description: Only branches whose name contains this text (e.g. "refs/tags/v2").

name: snapshot
title: Snapshot
